name: smwpatches-faster-climbing-with-x-y
title: Faster Climbing with X/Y
description:
This patch will allow you to move faster by pressing Y or X while climbing the vine, just like in sma2.
You can change the speed by yourself, but it is already prepared to be the same speed as sma2, so you can use it as it is patched.

Thanks to yoshifanatic for his help in creating it.

Credits are optional.
